name: Joint-venture partner owned by government-connected persons
description: Local partner's owners include officials or relatives without disclosure or fair valuation of their contribution.
fp: State-linked partners are common in some sectors and not inherently improper.

sources.text: OECD, Good Practice Guidance on Internal Controls, Ethics, and Compliance (2010)

Wolfsberg Group, Anti-Bribery and Corruption Compliance Programme Guidance (2017)
US DOJ and SEC, A Resource Guide to the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, Second Edition (2020)
